title: Croatian Noir Noir Dumplings
description: A hearty and savory dish that combines the best of Croatian and noir cuisine. These dumplings are a perfect comfort food.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine cubed bread, crumbled noir cheese, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out dum pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough, about 3 inches in diameter.
Place a tablespoon or two of the bread mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each dumpling with a little butter.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
